Electro - Hazmat.png|Unused Ghost skin icon, which can be seen in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] stat editor through the use of bugs. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The elves spawned by this tower are based on multiple enemies that appear in the [[Violent Night Event]]. **The [[Elf]] is based on the [[Basic Elf (Cold Ambush)|Basic Elf]]. **The [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]] is based on the [[Bomber Elf (Cold Ambush)|enemy of the same name]]. **The [[Guardian Elf]] is based on the [[Cookie Guard (Cold Ambush)|Cookie Guard]]. **The [[Gift Bomber]] is based on the [[Sleigh (Cold Ambush)|Sleigh]]. **The [[Ripped Elf (Unit)|Ripped Elf]] is based on the [[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)|enemy of the same name]]. **The [[Snowball Elf]], [[Cannoneer Elf]] and [[Gunner Elf]] do not appear to be based on any enemy in the event. *The '''Elf Camp''' once had four additional skins alongside the Default skin, all of which are unused. **Oddly, the chronological sequence of the four skins and their names are the same as the [[Electroshocker]]'s first four skins. ***Additionally, the [[Electroshocker]]'s icons from before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] of its respective skins are reused for the '''Elf Camp's''' skins. However, no model of the tower itself is displayed when equipping any of the '''Elf Camp's''' skins. ****The {{Color|Unobtainable|Ghost}} skin uses the same icon as the {{Color|Unobtainable|Hazmat}} skin. *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} skin is based on its previous default appearance. *The sword used by the [[Guardian Elf]] is likely based on the [[w:c:Toy Sword|Toy Sword]] from ''Reason 2 Die: Awakening''. *The {{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} skin is a submission made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/445244958/profile DaddyDonuts]. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' -
